description: This Java source file defines a builder class for constructing immutable SearchQuery objects with a fluent API. It allows setting filters, sorting options, and limits for search queries in a thread-unsafe manner.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchQueryBuilder
classes.description: A builder class that provides a fluent API for constructing immutable SearchQuery instances, allowing configuration of filters, sorting, and limits.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with the specified SearchFilter.

methods.name: sortAsc
methods.description: Adds an ascending sort option for the given property path.

methods.name: sortDesc
methods.description: Adds a descending sort option for the given property path.

methods.name: removeSortOptionFor
methods.description: Removes the sort option for a specific property path.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of results with specified offset and count.

methods.name: removeLimitation
methods.description: Removes any set limit on the search query.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the immutable SearchQuery object based on current builder state.
